name: Multi Select
summary: Multi Select. Commits several predefined values while keeping the trigger width and selected tokens stable.

lifecycle.compatibility: Available for controlled production evaluation; the contract may still be refined.
lifecycle.rationale: The multi-value popup and token contract remains beta while async option replacement and manual assistive-technology evidence are completed.
knownLimitations: Consumers must keep object option identity stable across refreshes.
Very large selected sets require a product-specific summary or review surface.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: id
api.description: Stable identifier value used by the id contract.

api.name: placeholder
api.description: Short input hint shown only while no value is present.

api.name: emptyText
api.description: Visible and announced copy when the data collection has no items.

api.name: loadingText
api.description: Visible and announced copy while asynchronous data is loading.

api.name: errorText
api.description: Visible and announced copy when loading the data collection fails.

api.name: ariaLabel
api.description: Accessible name used when visible content is not sufficient.

api.name: ariaLabelledBy
api.description: Space-separated element ids that provide the accessible name and take precedence over ariaLabel.

api.name: ariaDescribedBy
api.description: Space-separated element ids composed with Form Field hints and validation descriptions.

api.name: options
api.description: Authoritative option collection presented by the selection control.

api.name: optionsState
api.description: Controls whether options are interactive or replaced by an announced loading/error state.

api.name: identityMatcher
api.description: Compares option values when object identity is not stable across refreshes.

api.name: trackBy
api.description: Returns the stable identity used to retain rendered items across updates.

api.name: stringify
api.description: Converts a domain value into the human-readable label shown to users.

api.name: disabledHandler
api.description: Determines whether an individual option or item is unavailable.

api.name: optionTemplate
api.description: Template used to render one option with its typed context.

api.name: selectedTemplate
api.description: Template used to render the committed selection.

api.name: maxVisible
api.description: Upper or lower bound applied to the visible value.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Prevents user interaction and participates in the disabled-state contract.

api.name: readonly
api.description: Keeps the value perceivable while preventing user edits.

api.name: required
api.description: Marks the value as required and participates in Angular Forms validation.

api.name: invalid
api.description: Exposes an externally controlled invalid presentation state.

api.name: tabindex
api.description: Native sequential-focus order forwarded to the owned interactive element.

api.name: value
api.description: Controlled component value.

api.name: open
api.description: Controls whether the disclosure or overlay surface is visible.

api.name: valueChange
api.description: Notifies the consumer after the value change interaction completes.

notes: Works with Angular Forms through ControlValueAccessor.
Angular validator state and explicit KERN state inputs are combined.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens the list; Arrow keys move the active option.
Enter toggles the active option without closing the list.
Escape closes the list and Backspace removes the last token only from an empty query.
notes: The trigger exposes expansion, list ownership, and active descendant.
Selected values remain visible as named removable tokens.
Loading, empty, error, and selection-count changes are announced.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Typed multi-owner selection

guidance.useWhen: Use Multi Select when users choose several values from a bounded authoritative option set.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use Tags Input for user-authored values and Checkbox Group when the complete short option set should stay visible.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Use stable option values and identityMatcher for object values.
Use Tags Input instead when users may create an unbounded vocabulary.
Do not manually duplicate value and disabled state when Angular Forms owns the control.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify reactive-form value, touched, disabled, required and invalid state.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
